description: Test suite for the HpackEncoder class in the quiche HTTP/2 implementation, including tests for header encoding, dynamic table management, and string encoding strategies.

classes.name: HpackHeaderTablePeer
classes.description: Helper class to access internal header table entries for testing.

classes.name: HpackEncoderPeer
classes.description: Helper class to access internal methods and properties of HpackEncoder for testing.

classes.name: HpackEncoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing HpackEncoder with various strategies and header scenarios.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes dynamic header table entries and sets maximum size for tests.

methods.name: SaveHeaders
methods.description: Stores headers observed during encoding for verification.

methods.name: ExpectIndex
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for an indexed header.

methods.name: ExpectIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a literal header with index.

methods.name: ExpectNonIndexedLiteral
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a non-indexed literal header.

methods.name: ExpectString
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a string, choosing Huffman or identity encoding.

methods.name: ExpectHeaderTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Prepares expected encoding for a header table size update.

methods.name: CompareWithExpectedEncoding
methods.description: Compares actual encoding output with expected output for headers or representations.

methods.name: DynamicIndexToWireIndex
methods.description: Converts dynamic table index to HPACK wire index.
